canonical_project: Mill Hill County Durham Data Centre Power Project

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: AVK-SEG's October 2025 release says the UK project pipeline for data-centre-focused low-carbon behind-the-meter power includes a 30 MW consented site at Mill Hill, County Durham. Public evidence is strongest for power/microgrid infrastructure serving data centres rather than naming the end data centre operator.
